analysis.headline: USD/KRW eases to 1,334.1 on exporter sales while hot US CPI firms floor
analysis.summary: USD/KRW moved down to around 1,334.1 (ECB ref 1,334.10) after brisk exporter dollar selling and foreign net sales of dollar futures pushed Seoul daytime trading as low as 1,330.7 KRW. Overnight, however, hotter-than-expected October U.S. CPI (+0.4% m/m) lifted Treasury yields and hawkish Fed commentary, reinforcing downside support in a 1,330–1,338 KRW band.

analysis.headline: EUR/KRW breaks below 1,480 to 1,478.3 on post-CPI dollar surge and firm won
analysis.summary: EUR/KRW extended its slide to around 1,478.3 (ECB ref 1,478.32), slipping below the 1,480 KRW handle. Hotter-than-expected U.S. October inflation propelled the greenback higher and pushed EUR/USD down to 1.1081 amid Eurozone growth headwinds, while steady exporter dollar conversions in Seoul kept the won resilient across a 1,474–1,484 KRW range.

analysis.headline: JPY/KRW drops to 835.4 per 100 JPY as hot US CPI lifts USD/JPY near 160
analysis.summary: JPY/KRW retreated to around 8.35 KRW per JPY (~835.4 KRW per 100 JPY, ECB ref 8.354). Above-consensus U.S. October CPI sparked a jump in Treasury yields, driving USD/JPY up to 159.7 within striking distance of 160. Verbal intervention warnings from Tokyo and December BOJ rate hike prospects slowed yen losses, leaving the cross in an 832–840 KRW range.

analysis.headline: GBP/KRW retreats below 1,770 to 1,768.4 ahead of UK GDP amid higher US yields
analysis.summary: GBP/KRW declined to around 1,768.4 (ECB ref 1,768.43), giving up the 1,770 KRW level. Although sticky UK services inflation and the Bank of England’s restrictive 4.0% policy rate offered underlying support, surging U.S. Treasury yields and caution ahead of UK GDP data pulled GBP/USD down to 1.3256, keeping the cross soft within 1,764–1,775 KRW.

analysis.headline: CNY/KRW edges down to 200.1 as firm PBOC fixing meets resilient won
analysis.summary: CNY/KRW slipped slightly toward 200.1 (ECB ref 200.07) within a narrow 199.5–200.7 KRW band, testing the psychological 200.0 KRW support. Despite broad U.S. dollar strength following hot U.S. CPI data, the PBOC anchored yuan stability via firmer daily fixings and ample liquidity, while USD/KRW’s drop to 1,334.1 weighed mildly on the cross.

AUD.headline: AUD slides to 910.0 KRW on surging US yields and cautious risk mood
AUD.brief: The Australian dollar fell to 910.0 KRW as post-CPI U.S. yield gains and cautious global growth sentiment outweighed the RBA’s restrictive policy stance.

CAD.headline: CAD retreats to 936.3 KRW on widening Fed-BoC gap and soft oil
CAD.brief: The Canadian dollar slipped to 936.3 KRW, pressured by widening policy divergence between a hawkish Fed and easing BoC alongside subdued oil and a firm won.

CHF.headline: CHF drops to 1,601.3 KRW as higher US yields weigh on low-yielders
CHF.brief: The Swiss franc declined to 1,601.3 KRW near the 1,600 mark as surging U.S. Treasury yields and the SNB’s low-rate posture pressured the currency against the won.

CNY.headline: CNY edges down to 200.1 KRW as PBOC fixing offsets strong dollar
CNY.brief: The Chinese yuan eased to 200.1 KRW; firmer PBOC daily fixings and liquidity injections cushioned post-CPI dollar strength while Seoul won gains weighed mildly.

EUR.headline: EUR breaks below 1,480 to 1,478.3 KRW as EUR/USD slides to 1.108
EUR.brief: The euro fell to 1,478.3 KRW as hot U.S. inflation drove EUR/USD down to 1.1081 amid Eurozone growth concerns, compounded by resilient Korean exporter flows.

GBP.headline: GBP slips below 1,770 to 1,768.4 KRW ahead of UK GDP release
GBP.brief: The British pound retreated to 1,768.4 KRW as higher U.S. yields and caution ahead of UK GDP figures pulled cable lower despite the BoE’s 4.0% rate support.

HKD.headline: HKD eases to 170.1 KRW tracking lower USD/KRW reference level
HKD.brief: The Hong Kong dollar moved down to 170.1 KRW within its 7.75–7.85 USD peg band, closely mirroring the step down in the USD/KRW reference rate in Seoul.

JPY.headline: JPY falls to 835.4 per 100 JPY as hot US CPI pushes USD/JPY near 160
JPY.brief: The Japanese yen slid to 835.4 KRW per 100 JPY as U.S. CPI lifted USD/JPY to 159.7, overshadowing Tokyo’s intervention warnings and December BOJ hike bets.

KRW.headline: KRW firms to 1,334.1 vs USD on exporter flows while US CPI caps upside
KRW.brief: The Korean won strengthened to 1,334.1 per USD after touching 1,330.7 on exporter and futures selling, though hot U.S. October CPI curbed further overnight gains.

USD.headline: USD eases to 1,334.1 KRW on Seoul nego flows before US CPI firms floor
USD.brief: The U.S. dollar dipped to 1,334.1 KRW on daytime exporter sales in Seoul, but above-forecast October CPI (+0.4% m/m) boosted yields and defended the 1,330s floor.
